logic: label/quote text uses 100%|pure|all while spec evidence lists 2+ fibres
source_quote: Only textile products exclusively composed of the same fibre may be labelled or marked as '100 %', 'pure' or 'all'. Those or similar terms shall not be used for other textile products.
message_annotation: ZH: 规格含两种以上纤维时禁用 100%/pure/all，须改为完整成分标注

logic: multi-fibre product missing full name+percentage list or wrong order
source_quote: A textile product shall be labelled or marked with the name and percentage by weight of all constituent fibres in descending order.
message_annotation: ZH: 须按重量降序列出全部纤维名称与百分比

logic: fibre words outside Annex I list (spandex/lycra vs elastane; polyester No 35; cotton No 5)
source_ref: Reg (EU) 1007/2011 Art 5(1) + Annex I Nos 5, 35, 43
source_quote: Only the textile fibre names listed in Annex I shall be used for the description of fibre compositions on labels and markings. Annex I: 5 cotton; 35 polyester; 43 elastane (elastofibre composed of at least 85 % ... segmented polyurethane).
message_annotation: ZH: 消费者标签用 elastane 而非 spandex/lycra；贸易描述可保留 spandex

logic: market=DE and fibre composition text not in German
source_quote: The labelling or marking shall be provided in the official language or languages of the Member State on the territory of which the textile products are made available to the consumer, unless the Member State concerned provides otherwise.
message_annotation: ZH: 面向德国消费者时成分信息须用德语

logic: declared vs analysed composition within tolerance arguments
source_quote: A manufacturing tolerance of 3 % shall be permitted between the stated fibre composition ... extraneous fibres ... 2 % of the total weight ... 5 % ... carding process, provided this quantity is justified as being technically unavoidable in good manufacturing practice and is not added as a matter of routine.
message_annotation: ZH: 3% 为分析公差；2%/5% 仅指工艺上不可避免的外来纤维，不能解释故意添加的 5% 氨纶

logic: applicability of the Regulation not yet established
source_ref: Reg (EU) 1007/2011 Art 2(2)(a), Art 4, Art 17(2) + Annex V
source_quote: products containing at least 80 % by weight of textile fibres [treated as textile products]; Textile products shall only be made available on the market provided such products are labelled ... in compliance; The indication ... of textile products listed in Annex V is not required.
message_annotation: ZH: 先判定是否在适用范围；不得把部分规则通过表述为全面合规

logic: two places on same product state conflicting fibre/gsm/moq/unit info
source_quote: The labelling or marking shall not be misleading and shall be carried out in such a way that the consumer can easily understand [..] ensure that any information supplied when textile products are made available on the market cannot be confused with the textile fibre names and the descriptions of fibre compositions.
message_annotation: ZH: 同一商品成分/克重/起订量前后矛盾即误导，拦截并要求先取证澄清

logic: incoterm used without the named place/port the rule requires
source_ref: trade.gov Know Your Incoterms, Incoterms 2020 rule list
source_quote: EXW - Ex Works (insert place of delivery) ... FOB - Free on Board (insert named port of loading) [each of the 11 rules names a required place]
message_annotation: ZH: 每个术语必须带指定地点，禁止模型自行补全

logic: incoterm cited without stating which version applies
source_ref: trade.gov Know Your Incoterms, FAQ 2010-vs-2020
source_quote: They need to clearly specify the chosen version of Incoterms being used (i.e., Incoterms 2010, Incoterms 2020, or any earlier version).
message_annotation: ZH: 单据须明示 Incoterms 版本

logic: quote treats Incoterms as covering payment timing/title/price list/customs docs/non-conformity liability/dispute resolution
source_ref: trade.gov Know Your Incoterms, 'What Incoterms Do Not Cover'
source_quote: [Incoterms] do not: address all the conditions of a sale; identify the goods being sold nor list the contract price; reference the method nor timing of payment negotiated between the seller or buyer; when title, or ownership of the goods, passes from the seller to the buyer; specify which documents must be provided ...; and address liability for the failure to provide the goods in conformity ... nor dispute resolution mechanisms.
message_annotation: ZH: 付款时间/所有权/单据/违约责任须单独成条，不得依赖贸易术语

logic: sum of payment percentages != 100
source_ref: 演示商家自定模板（非外部事实）
message_annotation: ZH: 付款比例合计须为 100%

logic: validity missing or zero on outward quote
source_ref: 演示商家自定模板（非外部事实）
message_annotation: ZH: 对外报价须含有效期

logic: margin below team threshold requires exception approver
source_ref: 演示商家自定模板；阈值待商家后台真实数据替换
message_annotation: ZH: 低于内部毛利线转例外审批

logic: quote states certified/in-stock/guaranteed-delivery without a source record
source_ref: 演示商家自定红线（对应 R-EU-MISLEAD 的业务执行细则）
message_annotation: ZH: 无证据不得生成事实承诺

logic: Alibaba.com RFQ reply structure/length vs official platform rules
source_ref: 待导入国际站商家端公开规则文档后建模
message_annotation: ZH: 当前仅做结构提示，不声称覆盖平台规则

logic: Amazon listing completeness vs official seller documentation
source_ref: 待导入 Amazon 卖家公开规则文档后建模
message_annotation: ZH: 同上

logic: superlative/unverifiable claim (best|cheapest|guaranteed|premium quality)
source_ref: 演示商家自定禁用词表（数据集内真实示例见 remark 含「最便宜」商品）
message_annotation: ZH: 无实证的夸大表述须删除或给出依据

logic: market=DE first contact uses informal salutation
source_ref: 本队整理的商务写作约定（非法规来源）
message_annotation: DE: 首函惯例 Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren / Sie；约定而非法定要求

logic: listing title contains CJK characters (must be English on Alibaba.com)
source_ref: 阿里巴巴国际站规则 第24条；英文站发品规范
source_quote: 用户发布的信息应符合电子商务英文网站的规范及要求。商品名称应与商品图片、商品描述等其他信息要素相符，应尽量准确、完整、简洁。
message_annotation: ZH: 国际站标题必须英文；检测到中文标题即拦截，中文原名保留至 name_zh 字段

logic: category is a self-defined tag, not a platform leaf category (no hierarchy/id)
source_ref: 阿里巴巴国际站规则 第30条
source_quote: 商品应放置相关性高且最合适的最小类目下，有可匹配类目时不能放置在others类目下。用户将商品放置在与商品类别无直接联系的类目下的行为视为错放类目。
message_annotation: ZH: 内部标签(Men-T-Shirt等)须映射到平台叶子类目ID后才能发品

logic: same SKU expands to multiple listing rows differing only by price tier
source_ref: 阿里巴巴国际站规则 第33条(重复铺货)
source_quote: 重复铺货，指于同一平台上由同一会员发布产品信息，而该产品信息跟曾经发布并仍然出现于平台上的产品信息完全相同或近似。完全相同的产品信息指：产品信息的标题、关键词、属性、描述及图片完全相同。
message_annotation: ZH: 同一SKU的阶梯价须聚合为1个listing+N档阶梯价，禁止按行发品

logic: MOQ <= 5 or minimum tier price < 5 must be genuinely executable
source_ref: 商品信息滥发处罚规则解读(虚假价格/MOQ)
source_quote: 虚假价格/MOQ的定义：商品的发布价格区间与同行业同类商品市场价格相比相差甚远…或虚报最小起订量(MOQ)等行为。
message_annotation: ZH: 低MOQ(<=5)与极低价(<5)须逐条确认真实可成交，否则判定虚假价格/MOQ

logic: description embeds third-party supplier name and source URL (offsite引流/第三方主体泄露)
source_ref: 阿里巴巴国际站规则 第21/23条
source_quote: 用户发布的信息应真实、准确、合法、有效…卖家应尊重他人的知识产权。禁止发布虚假或夸大的信息。
message_annotation: ZH: 发品描述不得含供应商主体与来源外链；证据移入独立来源表

logic: material=100% Cotton but title lists other fibres (Spandex/Polyester etc.)
source_ref: Reg (EU) 1007/2011 Art 7(1)；阿里巴巴国际站规则 第19/26条(如实描述)
source_quote: Only textile products exclusively composed of the same fibre may be labelled or marked as '100%', 'pure' or 'all'.
message_annotation: ZH: 成分100%声称与标题纤维冲突，先定性(取页面原文或标记DISPUTED)再允许发品

logic: listings mixed between CNY and USD within one catalog
source_ref: 阿里巴巴国际站规则 第27条(价格与计量单位如实填写)
source_quote: 付款和运输方式应与供应商的实际服务能力相符，如实填写…计量单位…价格等。
message_annotation: ZH: 同一目录币种混排(USD16/CNY70)，发品须统一为平台标价币种

logic: cross-border customs declaration requires HS code, absent from listing fields
source_ref: 阿里巴巴一达通数智报关要求
source_quote: 交易品须填写美国海关编码(HS码)；定制品可不填。
message_annotation: ZH: 报关/退税须HS编码，当前无此字段；交易品缺失阻断、定制品可豁免
